title: Extending Theorems of Boros and Menzer
summary: We extend results of Boros and Menzer on the alternative equation $f(x)f(y)=0$ for generalized polynomials $f$, and their theorems on the conditional inequality $f(x)f(y)\ge 0$ for generalized monomials $f$ of even degree. We use similar methods and ideas. We replace the largeness, of the respective Borel plane set $D$, in the measure or in the Baire category sense, by its largeness in the mixed measure-category sense.
